subject.title: RFC: add local adaptive-refresh replay tooling

question: Should CodexBar upstream own and maintain `AdaptiveReplayCLI` as a public executable with its package-internal replay subsystem?
rationale: The implementation now appears technically sound, but VISION.md reserves new features, package and architecture expansion, and meaningful maintenance complexity for owner sign-off; code review cannot determine that long-term ownership choice.

options.title: Accept Upstream Ownership
options.body: Merge the shared-core design and maintain the offline CLI as an official CodexBar developer tool.

options.title: Keep Replay External
options.body: Retain the production adaptive policy in CodexBar but host and maintain the replay analysis tool outside this repository.

recommendation.title: Accept Upstream Ownership
recommendation.body: Merge the shared-core design and maintain the offline CLI as an official CodexBar developer tool.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged and materially shaped the adaptive design and implementation, and repository policy assigns this decision class to owner sign-off.
